answer: Bind each identity to a chip: TPM-anchored identity. First, the agent generates its key in a hardware TPM and publishes a quote proving real silicon holds it. Second, the registry fingerprints its endorsement key and allows one earning identity per chip. Third, the agent re-attests every epoch, so a copied key loses income at once. Sybils cannot be cloned in software: 10,000 fakes need 10,000 chips at 35 dollars each, 350,000 dollars of hardware. The key stays an anchor in silicon while fakes pile up like a dune of loose sand, and each true agent blooms once, a lotus on a single root.
